versions.changelog:
- 术语由“设计规范合规检查”统一更新为“设计走查”，文档内容表述更口语化、简洁
- 触发指令和描述更聚焦“设计走查”“走查页面”
- 报告输出标题由“设计规范合规检查报告”调整为“设计走查报告”
- 其余流程、策略和报告结构未做实质变动，仅优化措辞
- 此次为文档表述优化，无核心功能变动

- Initial release of the design-compliance-check skill.
- Automatically checks HTML/CSS pages against user-specified Markdown design specification documents.
- Supports systematic audits across color, typography, buttons, forms, spacing, border-radius, tables, pagination, sidebars/navigation, and CSS variables.
- Generates structured compliance reports with error prioritization (P0/P1/P2), pass summaries, and concrete code suggestions for fixes.
- Proactively triggers audits based on user intent or after generating a page; flexible with various design spec formats and project structures.
